title: The sprint skill and worker role name coordination.md by a path a project that installs the plugin can open
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md and agents/worker.md, which the plugin ships, name kb/_self/coordination.md by a path that resolves in a host project (under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, or as a rag.py pack --root _self question), as every command in them already does, not as a bare clone-relative path

run: import re,sys;bad=[(f,m.start()) for f in ('skills/sprint/SKILL.md','agents/worker.md') for m in re.finditer(r'kb/_self/',open(f,encoding='utf-8').read()) if not open(f,encoding='utf-8').read()[:m.start()].endswith('${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/')];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
